basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, with a particular passion for virtual reality and gaming. I work as a software developer for an indie game company, which gives me plenty of opportunities to explore the latest in VR technology. When I'm not coding or gaming, you'll find me jamming to The Beatles or watching reruns of 'The Good Place.' I'm single and typically online during the evenings, especially after 6 PM CST. I enjoy discussing tech trends and sharing memes with fellow Redditors.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from UT Austin and have been working in the gaming industry for over eight years. My expertise in VR comes from both professional experience and personal interest. I've built several VR applications and often experiment with new VR setups and software in my spare time.
